answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in ivory, verified in oasis, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ember check. A farm of 1719 identities would post 2272 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
